glosses: A working-class punk rock subgenre of the 1970s, sometimes associated with racism.

examples.text: A way for Oi musicians to avoid responsibility for acts of violence that were preceded by listening to Oi is the claim that what people do with their music is out of the control of the musicians themselves.
Oi! is characterized by cleaner guitars and slower tempos than most punk music, and many Oi! songs feature sing-along, "soccer chant" choruses.
Sometimes oi sits and thinks, and sometimes oi just sits.
Why, where be oi, and what be oi a doin’, / A sleepin’ out, just when the dews du rise?
